name: Jindal Saw Ltd
title: Jindal Saw Ltd - 500378 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 standalone EBITDA fell to INR413 crore from INR527 crore in Q3 as MENA shipments froze since March and ductile iron pipe demand stalled; management sees ductile iron overcapacity.

utilisation.quote: operations have been reduced to meet essential demand

capex.peers_comment: Management said industry peers are adding capacity in MENA and stainless; it called ductile iron pipe capacity oversupplied.
capex.quote: in ductile iron pipes, there may be some oversupply in terms of capacities

triggers.label: Abu Dhabi deliveries 52k → 48k tons
triggers.quote: Abu Dhabi company delivered approximately 48,000 tons pipes as compared to 52,000 tons in Q3

triggers.label: Ductile iron overcapacity acknowledged
triggers.quote: there may be some oversupply in terms of capacities

triggers.label: Export shipments suspended since March
triggers.quote: all export shipments have been suspended since March '26

triggers.label: Q1 FY27 impact expected to persist
triggers.quote: we expect its impact on Q1 results of the current year also

triggers.label: Escalation pass-through limited
triggers.quote: there is no guarantee that this cost would eventually be passed on to the buyer

guidance.quote: For this year, we expect INR500 crores to INR600 crores.
we would still be in the range of, let's say, 2, 2.5 debt to EBITDA, all including working capital, everything.

prior_guidance_check.quote: The Q4 FY '26 performance did not meet our expectation of exceeding Q3 results

red_flags.label: Working capital debt rising; consol net debt INR2,528 crore
red_flags.quote: Net institutional debt on a consol basis has reduced to INR2,528 crores

red_flags.label: API monogram suspended on seamless pipes
red_flags.quote: A suspension letter was issued prohibiting the use of the API monogram on our seamless pipes.

red_flags.label: Rupee-driven FX loss INR48 crore
red_flags.quote: Company also reported a INR48 crores foreign exchange cost during this quarter

evasions.quote: if you say that this has bottomed out, maybe, may not be.
No. So we never mentioned the coal.
we are not discussing because we have multiple products
